tasks.title: Email notification on task assignment — auto-notify assignee when a Mission Control task is assigned
tasks.description:
**Owner:** [ASSIGN:Phil Eaton]
**Assigned by:** Phil Eaton (7/17) via @Exobot email command.
**Status:** 🟡 Requested — build the notifier.

**Request (Phil):** Set up an email notification system so that when someone is assigned a Mission Control task, that person automatically receives an email letting them know a new task was assigned to them.

**Why it's feasible now:** The Supabase `tasks` table already carries `assigned_email`, `assigned_to`, and `assigned_at` on every row. A watcher can diff newly-assigned tasks and email the assignee — no schema change needed.

**Proposed implementation (for Phil to approve):**
1. New script `scripts/task-assignment-notifier.py` — polls Supabase `tasks` for rows where `assigned_email` is set and the assignment is new/changed since last run (track a seen-state file keyed on task id + assigned_email + assigned_at, same pattern as the priority-inbox / decision-send watchers).
2. On a new assignment, send an email via ProtonMail Bridge/msmtp to the assignee: subject "New Mission Control task assigned to you: <title>", body with title, description snippet, due date, board link (localhost:8080). CC/notify Jon optional.
3. Schedule via launchd (e.g. every 10 min), wrapped in task_ledger.py, and register with the cron failure watchdog.
4. Guardrails: only notify on assignments to real Exos addresses; dedupe so re-runs never double-send; skip if assigned_email == the person who created it (self-assign) if desired.

**Next step:** Phil approves the approach (or tweaks cadence / who gets CC'd), then Exo builds + schedules it.
